remark:
NOTE 1 : TOTAL AREA OF THE PROJECT AS PER APPROVED SITE PLAN IS 1083.72 SQ.YD., MULTIPLYING IT BY 9, IT BECOMES 9753.48 SQ.FT AND DIVIDING THE SAME BY 10.76 IT BECOMES 906.45 SQ.MTR, JDA HAS APPROVED ARCHITECT'S MAP BASED ON THE AFOREMENTIONED CALCULATION, HOWEVER WHILE TYPING BUILDING PERMISSION LETTER JDA OFFICER HAS MADE A CLERICAL ERROR IN COMPUTING AREA OF THE PROJECT AS THEY HAVE DIRECTLY CONVERTED SQ.YD. AREA OF 1083.72 SQ.YD. INTO SQ.MTR. THEREBY IT IS MENTIONED AS 904.45 SQ.MTR IN BUILDING SANCTION PLAN. THE MAPS, THE AREA CALCULATIONS, THE BUILDING DIMENSIONS ARE BASED ON ACTUAL SITE LOCATION AREA I.E, 906.45 SQ.MTR. AND THUS IT IS CONSIDERED FOR RERA PROJECT REGISTRATION AS WELL. ALSO, SUCH CALCULATION ERROR BEING BASED ON FORMULA ROUND OFF IS IGONRED HEREWITH. KINDLY TAKE A NOTE.

Note 2: Parking mentioned in Common Area Details as 26 Cars and 27 Two Wheelers for Residents and 3 Cars and 3 Two Wheelers for Visitors. For residents, 21  Cars out of the total capacity is parked in the semi-covered area thus it is shown under open area parking and only 5 cars are exclusively covered so shown under stilt parking area. Similarly for two Wheelers, 23 are covered and shown under stilt and 4 are shown under open area. Visitors parking is under open area only for both cars and scooters. Kindly take a note.

Note 3: The promoter has provisioned a club house in the stilt floor area. This being a facility is for the use and disposal of the residents and is not available for sale.

Amount paid to land owner. (Method of land valuation)

Estimated Cost of Construction as certified by Engineer

For the purposes of sub-clause (D) of clause (I) of sub - section (2) of section 4, the construction cost shall be the total cost incurred by the promoter, towards the on - site expenditure for the physical development of the project and includes fees payable to the architects, consultants, project managers / staff including engineers, marketing agents etc. fees / charges / security deposit payable to various departments / authorities, Labor Cess, VAT which are incurred during the development of the project.

On-site expenditure for development of entire project excluding cost of construction as per (ii) above, i.e.
